sentences.text: Oscar De La Hoya -LRB- -LSB- deɪləˈhɔɪ.ə -RSB- born February 4 , 1973 -RRB- is a former professional boxer who competed from 1992 to 2008 .	professional boxer	professional boxer
He holds dual American and Mexican citizenship .

Nicknamed `` The Golden Boy '' , De La Hoya represented the United States at the 1992 Summer Olympics , winning a gold medal in the lightweight division shortly after graduating from James A. Garfield High School .	1992 Summer Olympics	1992 Summer Olympics	lightweight	lightweight	James A. Garfield High School	Garfield High School (Los Angeles County, California)
He was born in Los Angeles , California , and comes from a boxing family .	Los Angeles	Los Angeles	California	California
His grandfather Vicente , father Joel Sr. and brother Joel Jr. were all boxers .

De La Hoya was named Fighter of the Year by The Ring magazine in 1995 , and was their top-rated fighter in the world , pound for pound , in 1997 and 1998 .	Fighter of the Year	The Ring magazine Fighter of the Year	pound for pound	The Ring magazine Pound for Pound
He officially announced his retirement in 2009 , after a professional career spanning sixteen years .

As a professional , De La Hoya won ten world titles in six different weight classes , including the lineal championship in three weight classes .	six different weight classes	list of boxing sextuple champions	lineal championship	lineal championship

He also generated approximately $ 700 million in pay-per-view income , making him the top pay-per-view earner before being surpassed by Floyd Mayweather Jr. and Manny Pacquiao .	pay-per-view	pay-per-view	Manny Pacquiao	Manny Pacquiao
In 2002 , De La Hoya founded Golden Boy Promotions , a combat sport promotional firm .	Golden Boy Promotions	Golden Boy Promotions

He is the first American of Mexican descent to own a national boxing promotional firm and one of the few boxers to take on promotional responsibilities while still active .	American of Mexican descent	Hispanic and Latino Americans
